previousAcceptedState.public: v4.3.1 / Windows R44 remains public authority
previousAcceptedState.ownerLocal: R45 backend direct-route hotfix PASS; visual post-click rendering UNPROVEN

mainBlocker: Pre-connect Speed/DIRECT worker completed successfully but the WPF dashboard still showed a display error/dashes.

facts.claim: Speed/DIRECT backend itself was healthy after R45.
The UI failure occurred in Paint-Performance under Set-StrictMode because direct_speed() does not return an optional checked key and the UI read $p.checked unguarded.
evidence: Independent pwsh StrictMode repro: a hashtable lacking checked raises PropertyNotFoundException.
app/engine.py direct_speed() result has no checked key.
Second smoke backend exit=0 while evidence/gui.json reported statusTitle=خطای نمایش نتیجه.

decision.selected: Treat checked as optional in Paint-Performance: use ContainsKey('checked') before reading it, otherwise use current UTC for freshness.
decision.rationale: Minimum sufficient change: fixes the proven display exception without changing backend/network behavior.

rejected.option: Add a synthetic checked field to every backend speed result
rejected.reason: Broader backend contract mutation was unnecessary for an optional UI freshness value.

rejected.option: Suppress StrictMode or wrap the entire success handler in a generic ignore
rejected.reason: Would hide future contract errors instead of fixing the precise missing-key access.

failurePrevention.prevention: Optional result properties are feature-detected before access in WPF success painting.

limitation: This proves source-candidate WPF rendering and owner-network preservation. Exact packaged/fresh-installed R46 behavior still requires installer/hosted validation before public promotion.
exactNextAction: Run Linux installed non-mutating acceptance and broad local Windows/package regression, then promote only to hosted CI.
